reference.pathophysiology: Minutes-fast allergen exposure closes airways and crashes pressure as anaphylaxis needing thigh adrenaline, fluids and biphasic watch; C1-esterase swells without urticaria while CVID, XLA and SCID repeat sinopulmonary infections and forbid live vaccines until replaced or transplanted.
additionalDifferentials: Vasovagal versus mastocytosis versus carcinoid versus hereditary by pulse Darier niacin and C1-esterase
Anaphylaxis versus asthma versus angioedema by exposure wheeze and complement
CVID versus XLA versus SCID by onset B-cells and TRECs
